pattern: a contradicting preference replaces the active memory
experience: The user asks the voice agent for more detail than an active memory allows. The agent proposes the new preference in place of that memory, by its text, and does not save a second memory on the same subject, which would leave two that contradict each other.

voiceAgent: Keep updates to one sentence per agent.

memory_propose.message: Shown to the user as a card. Keep working.
